column3: “the men of war” renders “the people of the army.”
“of human beings” renders “souls of humankind (adam)” (also in verses 40 and 46).
“the Lord’s levy” renders “the tax (mekhes) for the LORD” (also in verses 38–41).
“the Lord’s offering” renders “the contribution of the LORD.”
NASB breaks off this verse with a dash and resumes the sentence in verse 47.
“have taken a census of” renders “have lifted up the head of,” and “in our charge” renders “in our hand.”
“as an offering” renders “the qorban,” and “necklaces” renders “kumaz,” an ornament whose identity is uncertain.
